· Significant drop relative to SMA100 (KRW 108,350)/SMA200 (KRW 100,592): Continued weakening of long-term trend
· 52-week position at 25.1%: Approaching historical low range, exploring potential for rebound
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (41.8→30.3): Entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (417.7217→-346.1710): Bearish worsening, downward pressure continues after dead cross
· Bollinger Bands current price position (near lower band KRW 80,147): Approaching lower band, potential for breakdown if further decline
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 75,565): Close to 5-day/20-day low of KRW 76,010, forming a key support zone
· Swing resistance (KRW 89,550): First resistance zone for a short-term rebound
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High, 5-day low KRW 76,010): Confirmation of continued downtrend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.14x): Increased volume on recent decline, confirming selling pressure
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Potential for further decline due to RSI entering oversold and MACD bearish convergence, observe support at KRW 75,565 before considering action.
